subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: No test coverage for the new `live_preview` config. The existing test file already tests `fetchOptions` config in a 'contentstack fetch timeout' describe block using the same require-and-assert-on-options pattern, but there is no corresponding test verifying that `live_preview` is correctly populated from CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST / CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN env vars, nor that `enable` is false when the host is absent. The diff adds a new feature (live preview configuration) but does not extend the existing test file to cover it.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a describe('live_preview config') block to src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts with at minimum two tests mirroring the existing 'contentstack fetch timeout' pattern: (1) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST and CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN are set, assert options.live_preview equals { enable: true, host: <host>, management_token: <token> }; (2) when CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST is unset, assert options.live_preview.enable is false.
